image_query: Dilwara Temples Vimala Vasahi marble ceiling carving Mount Abu
tweets: Vimala Vasahi, Dilwara Temples, Mount Abu — built 1031 CE by minister Vimal Shah for Ṛṣabhanātha, first Tīrthaṅkara. Plain grey stone outside; within, white marble carved so fine the ceiling medallions read as lace, each cut from a single block.
